description:
The record written inside an archive, and read back to decide a restore.

Everything a restore needs to know before it overwrites anything: what made
the archive, when, what data root it was taken against, what it covers, whether
it is sensitive, and the contents to list. Round-trips through JSON so the same
value the capture wrote is the value the restore reads.

created_at.description: When it was taken. Opaque here; the surface stamps it from the clock.

data_root.description: The data root it was taken against, to notice a restore to a different one.

members.description: What is inside, for a listing shown before anything is overwritten.

product_version.description: The lemonfiber version that wrote it, checked against the one restoring.

schema.description: The archive format, checked before anything inside is trusted.

sensitive.description: Whether it carries credentials, and so must be handled as sensitive.
